load_data_contrastive_pairs: load training data from multiple paths into a MultiDataset for contrastive learning with configurable sampling
load_dataset_tensors: load PyTorch tensor files from a directory in split, full, or single loading mode
create_multidataset_sampling: create a MultiDataset that samples from multiple datasets with configurable probability weighting
apply_augmentation_tokens: apply mask, replace, delete, or shuffle augmentation to token tensors with configurable probability
load_passages_retrieval: load passages from JSONL or TSV files for passage retrieval with id, title, and text fields
